onboarding1.title: Welcome to M’go Pass!
onboarding1.description:
🎉 Discover Morocco’s first all-in-one game pass!
With M’go Pass, you can enjoy top venues — from playgrounds to museums to surf classes — all with one smart membership.
Whether you're a family, a young explorer, or a tourist, M’go Pass makes fun easy and affordable.

onboarding2.title: How M’go Pass Works
onboarding2.description:
🎟️ 1. Choose your membership (Kids, Adult, or Tourist)
📍 2. Explore included venues nearby
📲 3. Show your QR pass at the venue to redeem
✅ 4. Enjoy the game — 100% cash-free and easy!

onboarding3.description:
💰 Save hundreds of dirhams with just a few visits

description.title: Description of Pickuplay Service
description.content: Pickuplay is a platform that connects players to join, organize, and participate in pickup sports games. Users can discover games based on location, sport type, and schedule, join existing games, or create their own events.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.content: Users must be at least 18 years old to create an account. Minors may use the platform under the supervision and responsibility of a parent or legal guardian.

account.title: User Accounts
account.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and for all activities that occur under your account. Pickuplay reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

games.title: Game Participation
games.content: Pickuplay acts only as a platform to connect users. We do not organize or supervise games. Users are responsible for their own participation, conduct, and safety during games.

organizers.title: Game Organizers
organizers.content: Users who create games are responsible for providing accurate details, managing participants, and communicating any updates such as time, location, or cancellations.

payments.title: Payments and Fees
payments.content: Some games may require payment to join. Pickuplay facilitates payments but is not responsible for disputes between users and organizers regarding fees or refunds.

conduct.title: User Conduct
conduct.content: Users agree to behave respectfully and fairly. Harassment, discrimination, cheating, or unsafe behavior may result in account suspension or removal from the platform.

liability.title: Liability Limitations
liability.content: Participation in sports activities involves inherent risks. By using Pickuplay, you agree that Pickuplay is not liable for any injuries, damages, or losses incurred during games or events.

disclaimers.title: Service Disclaimers
disclaimers.content: Pickuplay provides its services 'as is' without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee the availability, quality, or safety of any games or participants.

faq.answer1: Pickuplay is a platform that helps players easily find, create, and join pickup sports games in their city. You can connect with other players and organize games in just a few taps.
faq.question2: How do I join a game?
faq.answer2: Open the Games section, choose a game that fits your schedule, and tap Join Game. If there are available spots, you will immediately be added to the participants list.
faq.question3: How do I create a game?
faq.answer3: Go to the Create Game screen, select the sport, location, date, and number of players, then publish the game. Other players will be able to see and join it.
faq.question4: Can I add guests to a game?
faq.answer4: Yes. When joining a game, you can add guests if the organizer allows it and if there are available spots remaining.
faq.question5: How do I cancel my participation in a game?
faq.answer5: Open the game you joined and tap Leave Game. Your spot will become available for other players.
faq.question6: How do I update my profile information?
faq.answer6: Go to your Profile screen, click on the gear icon, and tap Edit Profile. You can update your photo, city, bio, and other personal information.
faq.answer7: Pickuplay sends notifications for important updates such as new players joining your game, game reminders, or changes made by the organizer.
faq.question8: Why does the app ask for my location?
faq.answer8: Your location helps Pickuplay show games happening near you so you can easily find and join local games.
faq.question9: What should I do if I experience a problem in the app?
faq.answer9: If you encounter a technical issue or unexpected behavior, please contact support through the Help Center or report the problem in the app.
